blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu—Job-order (JO) workers of the Mandaue City Government may receive an additional ₱76 in their daily honorarium for three months under a proposal aimed at helping ease the financial burden on workers. City Councilor Joel Seno, chairman of the Committee on Appropriations, Budget and Finance, drafted Ordinance No. 131-2026. In it, he seeks to grant qualified JO personnel the temporary increase from Sept. 1 to Nov. 30, 2026. The Mandaue City Council has passed the proposal on first reading and will put it through further deliberations.
